import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.LineBundleRationalDivisor
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivisorModulesPrincipalRange
import AlgebraicJacobian.Cohomology.ModulesCoverConservativity

/-!
# Divisor presentations of line bundles

Rational coordinates identify a line bundle on a smooth integral curve with
the divisor module of its local rational generators. This comparison supplies
the divisor presentation required by the twisted Cartier-kernel construction.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite TopologicalSpace

namespace AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.LineBundle

attribute [local instance] functionFieldOverModule overModule divisorSectionsModule

variable (K : Type u) [Field K] {X : Scheme.{u}}
  [X.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]
  [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))] [IsIntegral X]
  [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]
  [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
omit [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]
  [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))] in
private theorem rationalSection_mem_of_local_range
    (L : X.Modules) (hL : IsLocallyTrivial L) (D : X.CurveDivisor)
    (hlocal : ∀ x : X, ∃ W : X.Opens, x ∈ W ∧
      ∀ (U : X.Opens), U ≤ W → ∀ hU : genericPoint X ∈ U,
        Set.range (rationalSection L hL U hU) =
          (divisorSections K D U : Set X.functionField))
    (U : X.Opens) (hU : genericPoint X ∈ U) (s : Γ(L, U)) :
    rationalSection L hL U hU s ∈ divisorSections K D U := by
  rw [mem_divisorSections_of_nonempty K ⟨_, hU⟩]
  intro x hx hxU
  obtain ⟨W, hxW, hW⟩ := hlocal x
  let V := W ⊓ U
  have hV : genericPoint X ∈ V := genericPoint_mem_of_nonempty ⟨x, hxW, hxU⟩
  have hs : rationalSection L hL V hV
      (L.presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_right : V ≤ U)).op s) ∈
      divisorSections K D V := by
    change _ ∈ (divisorSections K D V : Set X.functionField)
    rw [← hW V inf_le_left hV]
    exact ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hv := (mem_divisorSections_of_nonempty K ⟨_, hV⟩).mp hs x hx ⟨hxW, hxU⟩
  rwa [rationalSection_restrict] at hv

private noncomputable def toDivisorModulesApp
    (L : X.Modules) (hL : IsLocallyTrivial L) (D : X.CurveDivisor)
    (hmem : ∀ (U : X.Opens) (hU : genericPoint X ∈ U) (s : Γ(L, U)),
      rationalSection L hL U hU s ∈ divisorSections K D U)
    (U : X.Opens) : Γ(L, U) →+ Γ(divisorModules K D, U) := by
  classical
  exact if hU : genericPoint X ∈ U then
    { toFun := fun s => ⟨rationalSection L hL U hU s, hmem U hU s⟩
      map_zero' := Subtype.ext (map_zero _)
      map_add' := fun s t => Subtype.ext (map_add _ s t) }
  else 0

private theorem toDivisorModulesApp_value
    (L : X.Modules) (hL : IsLocallyTrivial L) (D : X.CurveDivisor)
    (hmem : ∀ (U : X.Opens) (hU : genericPoint X ∈ U) (s : Γ(L, U)),
      rationalSection L hL U hU s ∈ divisorSections K D U)
    (U : X.Opens) (hU : genericPoint X ∈ U) (s : Γ(L, U)) :
    divisorVal K (toDivisorModulesApp K L hL D hmem U s) =
      rationalSection L hL U hU s := by
  simp only [toDivisorModulesApp, dif_pos hU]
  rfl

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
private noncomputable def toDivisorModules
    (L : X.Modules) (hL : IsLocallyTrivial L) (D : X.CurveDivisor)
    (hmem : ∀ (U : X.Opens) (hU : genericPoint X ∈ U) (s : Γ(L, U)),
      rationalSection L hL U hU s ∈ divisorSections K D U) :
    L ⟶ divisorModules K D where
  val := PresheafOfModules.homMk
    { app := fun U => AddCommGrpCat.ofHom (toDivisorModulesApp K L hL D hmem U.unop)
      naturality := by
        intro U V i
        ext s
        by_cases hV : (V.unop : Set X).Nonempty
        · have hηV := genericPoint_mem_of_nonempty hV
          have hηU := i.unop.le hηV
          apply divisorSection_ext K
          change divisorVal K (toDivisorModulesApp K L hL D hmem V.unop
              (L.presheaf.map i s)) =
            divisorVal K (divisorSectionsRes K D i.unop.le
              (toDivisorModulesApp K L hL D hmem U.unop s))
          rw [toDivisorModulesApp_value K L hL D hmem _ hηV,
            divisorVal_coe, divisorSectionsRes_coe K i.unop.le hV]
          rw [← divisorVal_coe K,
            toDivisorModulesApp_value K L hL D hmem _ hηU]
          exact rationalSection_restrict L hL i.unop.le hηV s
        · exact @Subsingleton.elim (divisorSections K D V.unop)
            (divisorSections_subsingleton_of_empty K hV) _ _ }
    (fun U r s => by
      by_cases hU : (U.unop : Set X).Nonempty
      · have hηU := genericPoint_mem_of_nonempty hU
        apply divisorSection_ext K
        change divisorVal K (toDivisorModulesApp K L hL D hmem U.unop (r • s)) =
          divisorVal K (QcohOn.qsmul (F := X.divisorSheaf K D) le_rfl r
            (toDivisorModulesApp K L hL D hmem U.unop s))
        rw [toDivisorModulesApp_value K L hL D hmem _ hηU,
          divisorVal_qsmul K hηU,
          toDivisorModulesApp_value K L hL D hmem _ hηU]
        exact rationalSection_smul L hL U.unop hηU r s
      · exact @Subsingleton.elim (divisorSections K D U.unop)
          (divisorSections_subsingleton_of_empty K hU) _ _)

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
private theorem toDivisorModules_isIso
    (L : X.Modules) (hL : IsLocallyTrivial L) (D : X.CurveDivisor)
    (hlocal : ∀ x : X, ∃ W : X.Opens, x ∈ W ∧
      ∀ (U : X.Opens), U ≤ W → ∀ hU : genericPoint X ∈ U,
        Set.range (rationalSection L hL U hU) =
          (divisorSections K D U : Set X.functionField)) :
    IsIso (toDivisorModules K L hL D
      (rationalSection_mem_of_local_range K L hL D hlocal)) := by
  classical
  let hmem := rationalSection_mem_of_local_range K L hL D hlocal
  have hlocal' := hlocal
  choose W hxW hW using hlocal'
  have hcover : iSup W = ⊤ := by
    apply top_unique
    intro x _
    exact Opens.mem_iSup.mpr ⟨x, hxW x⟩
  apply (Modules.Hom.isIso_iff_isIso_restrict _
    (X.openCoverOfIsOpenCover W hcover)).mpr
  intro x
  apply Modules.Hom.isIso_iff_isIso_app.mpr
  intro V
  apply (ConcreteCategory.isIso_iff_bijective _).mpr
  change Function.Bijective (toDivisorModulesApp K L hL D hmem ((W x).ι ''ᵁ V))
  by_cases hV : (((W x).ι ''ᵁ V : X.Opens) : Set X).Nonempty
  · have hηV := genericPoint_mem_of_nonempty hV
    constructor
    · intro s t hst
      apply rationalSection_injective L hL _ hηV
      have h := congrArg (divisorVal K) hst
      simpa only [toDivisorModulesApp_value K L hL D hmem _ hηV] using h
    · intro t
      have ht : divisorVal K t ∈ Set.range
          (rationalSection L hL ((W x).ι ''ᵁ V) hηV) := by
        rw [hW x _ ((W x).ι_image_le V) hηV]
        exact t.property
      obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := ht
      refine ⟨s, ?_⟩
      apply divisorSection_ext K
      exact (toDivisorModulesApp_value K L hL D hmem _ hηV s).trans hs
  · constructor
    · intro s t _
      exact L.isSheaf.section_ext (fun z hz => (hV ⟨z, hz⟩).elim)
    · intro t
      refine ⟨0, ?_⟩
      exact @Subsingleton.elim (divisorSections K D ((W x).ι ''ᵁ V))
        (divisorSections_subsingleton_of_empty K hV) _ _

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
/-- Every line bundle on a quasi-compact smooth integral curve is a divisor
module. The isomorphism is constructed from its actual rational coordinates. -/
theorem exists_iso_divisorModules (L : X.Modules) (hL : IsLocallyTrivial L) :
    ∃ D : X.CurveDivisor, Nonempty (L ≅ divisorModules K D) := by
  obtain ⟨D, hD⟩ := exists_divisor_of_rationalGenerators K L hL
  have hlocal : ∀ x : X, ∃ W : X.Opens, x ∈ W ∧
      ∀ (U : X.Opens), U ≤ W → ∀ hU : genericPoint X ∈ U,
        Set.range (rationalSection L hL U hU) =
          (divisorSections K D U : Set X.functionField) := by
    intro x
    obtain ⟨W, hxW, q, _, hgen, hcoeff⟩ := hD x
    refine ⟨W, hxW, ?_⟩
    intro U hUW hU
    letI : Nonempty U := ⟨⟨_, hU⟩⟩
    have heq := divisorSections_eq_of_coeffAt_eq_on K D
      (-divOf (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) q) U
      (fun z hz hzU => hcoeff z hz (hUW hzU))
    have hspan := congrArg (fun M : Submodule Γ(X, U) X.functionField =>
      (M : Set X.functionField)) (hgen U hUW inferInstance)
    change Set.range (rationalSection L hL U hU) = _ at hspan
    exact hspan.trans ((congrArg (fun M : Submodule K X.functionField =>
      (M : Set X.functionField)) heq).trans
        (divisorSections_neg_divOf_eq_span K U q)).symm
  let φ := toDivisorModules K L hL D
    (rationalSection_mem_of_local_range K L hL D hlocal)
  letI : IsIso φ := toDivisorModules_isIso K L hL D hlocal
  exact ⟨D, ⟨asIso φ⟩⟩

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
/-- A line bundle with a nonzero global section admits an effective divisor
presentation. Normalizing the section to rational value one makes all local
divisor coefficients nonnegative. -/
theorem exists_effective_iso_divisorModules (L : X.Modules) (hL : IsLocallyTrivial L)
    (s : Γ(L, ⊤)) (hs : s ≠ 0) :
    ∃ D : X.CurveDivisor, 0 ≤ D ∧ Nonempty (L ≅ divisorModules K D) := by
  obtain ⟨D, ⟨e⟩⟩ := exists_iso_divisorModules K L hL
  let t : Γ(divisorModules K D, ⊤) := e.hom.app ⊤ s
  have ht : t ≠ 0 := by
    intro ht
    have hinj := (ConcreteCategory.isIso_iff_bijective (e.hom.app ⊤)).mp inferInstance
    exact hs (hinj.1 (ht.trans (map_zero (e.hom.app ⊤).hom).symm))
  have hval : divisorVal K t ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    exact ht (divisorSection_ext K (h.trans (by rfl)))
  let g : X.functionFieldˣ := Units.mk0 (divisorVal K t) hval
  let E := D - divOf (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) g⁻¹
  let e' : divisorModules K D ≅ divisorModules K E := mulEquivDivisorModules K g⁻¹ D
  let t' : Γ(divisorModules K E, ⊤) := e'.hom.app ⊤ t
  have htop : ((⊤ : X.Opens) : Set X).Nonempty := ⟨genericPoint X, trivial⟩
  have ht' : divisorVal K t' = 1 := by
    change divisorVal K ((mulEquivDivisorModules K g⁻¹ D).hom.app ⊤ t) = 1
    rw [divisorVal_mulEquivDivisorModules K _ _ htop]
    change (divisorVal K t)⁻¹ * divisorVal K t = 1
    exact inv_mul_cancel₀ hval
  refine ⟨E, ?_, ⟨e ≪≫ e'⟩⟩
  apply Finsupp.le_def.mpr
  intro p
  have hb := (mem_divisorSections_of_nonempty K htop).mp
    (divisorVal_mem K t') p.1 p.2 trivial
  rw [ht', map_one] at hb
  exact WithZero.coe_le_coe.mp hb

end AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.LineBundle
